project: Due-Diligence Agent That Can Explain Why
track: Track 02: The Agent That Can Explain Why
use_case: Company due diligence before a supply contract, loan or investment

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: hypotheses and search plan; re-plans from Critic feedback

agents.name: Retriever
agents.role: Zetaris USL queries and web search

agents.name: Analyst
agents.role: quoted evidence extraction and cited decision memo

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: audits claims and coverage; rejects and sends work back to Planner

engines.where: hmem.py; used in agent.py (planner, analyst_draft, run_investigation)

meterless.injected_generator: agent.ask_json: the single function every agent uses for model calls, configured by LLM_BASE_URL / LLM_MODEL
meterless.sample_mode: samples/*.jsonl replayed when no LLM_API_KEY is set, or with --sample / SAMPLE_MODE=1 / UI checkbox
